narrative.overview: An open working plane with one manila card for the next slot. Stamp blue is rare. Simulations are labeled as simulations.
keyCharacteristics: Stamp blue on the stamp, the chart, and the active icon
Simulated results say nothing was sent

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Charts use stamp blue only. A failed day is named in a sentence.

rules.name: The Sentence Rule
rules.body: Status and empty states are sentences. Headers are not uppercase.

dos: Do keep manila on the next-slot card only.
Do say Simulated success or Simulated failure.
donts: Don't label a simulation as Published.
Don't use a resting drop shadow, a saturated sidebar, or type below 12px.
